podcast.body: Released on October 7, 1997. The band initially aimed to work with producer Gil Norton, who was unavailable due to commitments with Foo Fighters, leading him to recommend Warren Lives. The record deal with Private Music (a BMG subsidiary) unexpectedly folded on the day recording was scheduled to commence. Matthew Good, having secured a payout for two records through legal maneuvering, self-funded the album, with Warren Lives ultimately producing it. Despite initial skepticism from A&M/Universal, where an A&R executive bet it wouldn't sell more than 30,000 copies, the album's sales rapidly escalated from around 20,000 to over 100,000 records within months following the release of the "Operations" music video. "The Matthew Good Band from Underdogs released October 7th, 1997."
